mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 9 degrees now, broken clouds. Next 24 hours: high 10, low 2.

Donald Trump's defeat in the U.S. midterm elections could shift American policy toward Iran, Israel and Ukraine, analysts say.

The European Commission released its 2024-2026 report on Kosovo on November 4, confirming progress in areas overseen by the Ministry of Internal Affairs and its agencies.

RISE has introduced an innovative professional training model in Kosovo and is now accepting applications for its first cohort, aiming to combine theory with practical experience for new career opportunities.

Prime Minister Edi Rama said three student groups were threatened for wanting to meet him and announced an online dialogue window on Friday for anyone wishing to speak with him.

American logistics company Grabit will soon launch services in Pristina and plans to expand its courier and ride-share platform throughout Kosovo.
